Name: Foundry VTT
Description: Control Foundry Virtual Tabletop (v13/v14) from your Stream Deck: macros, scenes, the selected token, combat, music, pause, dice, roll tables and chat. Requires the Stream Deck Bridge Foundry module.

com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.macro.Name: Macro
com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.macro.Tooltip: Runs a Foundry macro, showing its image and name.

com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.scene.Name: Scene
com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.scene.Tooltip: Views or activates a Foundry scene, showing its thumbnail and whether it's active.

com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.token.Name: Token
com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.token.Tooltip: Shows the selected token (name, bar 1) and centres on it or opens its sheet.

com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.combat.Name: Combat
com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.combat.Tooltip: Drives the Foundry combat tracker: turns, rounds, start/end, initiative.

com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.playlist.Name: Music & Sounds
com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.playlist.Tooltip: Starts or stops a Foundry playlist or sound.

com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.system.Name: System
com.benwyrosdick.foundry-vtt.system.Tooltip: Pause, dice rolls, roll tables, chat messages, scene darkness and sidebar tabs.
